best_rules_serialized.name: names_in_criminal_proceedings
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names of accused persons in criminal cases after 'Strafsache gegen' or 'des Verbrechens/Vergehens'. Captures the full name including suffixes like 'und andere'.

best_rules_serialized.name: bare_names_in_criminal_context
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches bare names in criminal contexts like 'des [Name] betreffend' or 'des [Name] zu töten'.

best_rules_serialized.name: bare_names_after_verbs
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches bare names after verbs like 'wurde', 'besteht bei', 'entstammt'. Excludes trailing whitespace and common false positives.

best_rules_serialized.name: names_with_titles_and_suffixes

best_rules_serialized.name: bare_names_in_lists
